claim.text: Under the IMP regime used for Trojan analysis, for the same model and same IMP pruning path, the Trojan score is approximately zero for non-Trojan models.
Under the IMP regime used for Trojan analysis, for the same model and same IMP pruning path, there is a significantly positive peak in the Trojan score along that IMP path.
Under the IMP regime used for Trojan analysis, computing the Trojan score along the IMP pruning path yields a data-free detector of the pruning level where Trojan information is isolated.
The peak Trojan score from claim 2 characterizes the winning Trojan ticket.
